objective: All-question BCE; no change to fixed embeddings, preprocessing or labels
architecture: Exact previous attention architecture, h128, FFN256, score head64, four candidate tokens. Only head count and diagonal key/value masking vary. Query remains own h_i; own residual path unchanged. All cells have 272001 parameters and identical same-seed initial state tensors.
sampling: Full training permutation each epoch; seed+10000; all groups same question order for same seed
normalization: Per-coordinate mean/std from all training embeddings, no question features
optimizer: AdamW weight_decay0.001, existing treatment of all parameters, gradient clip1
checkpoint_selection: Highest official validation correct count, then lowest validation BCE, then earliest epoch
learning_rate_selection: Seed17: highest official validation correct count then lowest validation BCE; exact ties first LR. Other four seeds use chosen LR.
final_selection: Highest five-seed mean validation accuracy, ties protocol order (all parameter counts equal). Fixed seed17 single model, no ensemble.
primary_analysis: Paired mask contrasts at each head count; head contrasts against h4 under each mask; balanced mask/head main effects; difference-in-differences interactions relative h4. These describe equal-budget tuned pipelines; selected learning rates may differ.
secondary_analysis: Same-LR seed17 full factorial for each of the two already-run LR settings; exploratory single-seed control for LR confounding. Repair/harm counts versus include_h4; eval-mode train/validation gap; attention diagonal and normalized entropy as descriptions, not causal explanations.
uncertainty: 10000 paired question bootstrap resamples over seed-mean correctness; also report seed deltas and other-four-seed means. Reused validation, intervals conditional on selected models, no multiple-comparison correction; not an independent test.
test_policy: No test training, selection, predictions or scoring. Official integrity checker may check test file integrity/alignment.
